as_of_content:
'''Primus''' is a mentioned god who is known to have created the race of Cybertronians. He created the Thirteen Primes, which included [[Optimus Prime]] and [[Megatronus]], to battle his sworn nemesis, the planet-eater [[Unicron]].

== Appearances ==
* None technically, but mentioned in Megatronus' bio
